PERSONAL_IDENTITY.owner: E0/E8 identity and DB reviewer; Codex prepares evidence
PERSONAL_IDENTITY.entryRequirement: Review stable local_trusted/authenticated identity, company/user ownership and exact schema/route role binding before implementing the store; concurrency tests are outputs.
PERSONAL_IDENTITY.completionEvidence: Stable authenticated/local_trusted user identity, company+user predicates, same-role generated schema and absent-row concurrency tests

D3_DESIGN.owner: Codex security/Budget author plus assigned technical reviewer
D3_DESIGN.entryRequirement: Apply the accepted D3 policy and obtain source-bound credential/session/Budget design review before dependent runtime code; initial documentary mapping can establish that binding without paid calls.
D3_DESIGN.completionEvidence: Bind accepted credential/session/Budget design to actual source/roles/migrations and reconcile active instruction baseline; provider terms decision stays accepted

PROVIDER_ACCESS.owner: Deployment/company provider administrator; Codex qualification author
PROVIDER_ACCESS.entryRequirement: Before an authorized live probe: permitted provider account, approved purpose/region/retention, credentials, supported device, explicit cost ceiling and cleanup owner. Documentary work does not require credentials.
PROVIDER_ACCESS.completionEvidence: Explicitly available permitted credentials, device and test budget; official current provider contract plus admin accepted region/retention under company policy. No paid call from settings read

HOST_OWNER.owner: Deployment operator and isolated-host security reviewer; individual assignment required
HOST_OWNER.entryRequirement: For discovery, assign the deployment owner and provide source/config access. Before host implementation, accept exact deployment/containment design. Runtime malicious-fixture proof is produced in the qualification package.
HOST_OWNER.completionEvidence: Exact deployment files/revision, origin/headers/CSP/egress and resource containment facility; /1.a discovers, /1.b proves runtime

BROWSER_OWNER.owner: Replatform browser/worker owner; individual assignment required
BROWSER_OWNER.entryRequirement: Assign the upstream browser/worker owner and provide guarded attachment source plus protocol decision access for feasibility; qualification is the output.
BROWSER_OWNER.completionEvidence: Exact Browser Use/worker attachment seam and common identity/transport decision; no debugger port or sandbox bypass

HUMAN_INTAKE.owner: Codex intake author and asset/auth/storage reviewer
HUMAN_INTAKE.entryRequirement: Selected A is settled. Review actual actor/company/destination and same-role storage/transaction bindings before source edits; crash and revocation tests follow those edits.
HUMAN_INTAKE.completionEvidence: Selected A actor/company/destination authorization, same-role atomic publication, storage crash/revocation tests and generated schema order

PROCESSORS.entryRequirement: Provide pinned available converter/distribution candidates, license/deployment permission and disposable fixture environment. Format support and measured limits are qualification outputs.
PROCESSORS.completionEvidence: Pinned converter/image distribution, licensing/deployment availability, resource limits and damaged/encrypted/oversized fixture matrix

INDEX.owner: Index/storage and authorization owner; Codex consumer author
INDEX.entryRequirement: Review destination-scoped index writer/retrieval and revocation contracts with their source owner before binding; implementation tests prove the contract afterward.
INDEX.completionEvidence: Qualified writer/retrieval boundary with destination lineage, revocation, private-source and no implicit Memory publication evidence

ACTUAL_UI_HOST.owner: Target-host operator and Codex UI test author; TK acceptance
ACTUAL_UI_HOST.entryRequirement: Provide the actual supported application host, browser and input modes. The package executes and records the route regression; a prior passing run is not an entry requirement.
ACTUAL_UI_HOST.completionEvidence: Access to actual supported host/browser and input modes. Component/standalone mock is insufficient for the reported route defect

SECURITY_OWNER.owner: Credential/Budget service owners and assigned independent technical reviewer
SECURITY_OWNER.entryRequirement: Assign credential and Budget writer reviewers and approve exact source/roles/transaction design before code; enumerate all affected writers. Concurrency, cap and stop tests are completion evidence.
SECURITY_OWNER.completionEvidence: All resolver/export/mutation and spend writers, concurrency/cap enforcement, stop delivery and conservative unknown-exposure evidence; not preference-policy ownership

CMD.owner: Replatform Commander owner; Codex consumer; accountable upstream individual not yet recorded
CMD.entryRequirement: Upstream must supply the actual qualified distributed routing, per-user credential, cancellation and originating-result authority revision. Universe cannot implement a substitute authority to clear this gate.
CMD.completionEvidence: Actual E10-F001 routing, per-user credential, cancellation and originating result authority at a qualified revision; source existence alone does not close

WORKER_PUBLICATION.owner: Codex output-binding/materials author and auth/worker/security reviewers
WORKER_PUBLICATION.entryRequirement: Review accepted-output slot/cancel/permission-writer contracts and assign their owners. E2.2 produces accepted output binding; E4 later proves canonical publication and reply repair. Do not require E4 publication before E2.2 producer code.
WORKER_PUBLICATION.completionEvidence: Accepted-output owner/slot/cancel transaction, permission-writer lock coverage, receipt/revocation/competing-attempt tests and processor default-deny tuples

BROWSER_APPROVAL.owner: Replatform browser/approval owners; Codex browser consumer
BROWSER_APPROVAL.entryRequirement: Receive qualified upstream approval delivery/recovery and admitted worker attachment contracts before consumer code; streaming and takeover acceptance remain downstream.
BROWSER_APPROVAL.completionEvidence: Actual E8-F001/F004 approval delivery and stranded-answer recovery plus guarded admitted worker attachment; no replacement authority

CLOUD_ENV.entryRequirement: Receive the upstream credential/metadata boundary, authorized image/tier and actual cloud test environment with spend permission. Streaming/controller proof is produced by qualification.
CLOUD_ENV.completionEvidence: E8-F012 accepted credential/metadata boundary, authorized tier/image, headed stream/controller evidence and qualification spend authorization

LOCAL_WORKER.owner: Local worker/device operator and replatform authentication owner
LOCAL_WORKER.entryRequirement: Receive the authenticated outbound worker contract and an authorized supported device. Actual capture/offline/stale-input behavior is then qualified independently of cloud.
LOCAL_WORKER.completionEvidence: Authenticated outbound worker on actual supported OS/devices, selected-browser capture and stale/offline input rejection

TOOL_SECURITY.owner: Codex tool author and capability/auth reviewer
TOOL_SECURITY.entryRequirement: Review exact grant/action-link roles, migration and capability boundary before implementation; the real host and DB denial suite closes the consumer afterward.
TOOL_SECURITY.completionEvidence: Application-owned grant/action links, exact roles/migrations, generation/channel/revocation and real DB denial coverage; no frozen kernel privilege expansion

TERMINAL_WRITERS.owner: Canonical source/scheduler writer owners; Codex follow-up consumer
TERMINAL_WRITERS.entryRequirement: Enumerate and source-bind every enabled terminal/reopen writer and approve its same-owner intent/outbox design before adding follow-ups; crash coverage is generated afterward.
TERMINAL_WRITERS.completionEvidence: Enumerated terminal/reopen writers, reviewed same-owner intent/outbox architecture and crash/duplicate/revocation tests for every enabled source

MEDIA_PROVIDER.owner: Provider/deployment administrator, Codex media author and security/Budget reviewer
MEDIA_PROVIDER.entryRequirement: Provide each retained generation adapter contract and permitted account/environment/cost ceiling, with accepted credential and shared Budget producer bindings. Paid conformance follows implementation.
MEDIA_PROVIDER.completionEvidence: Actual generation adapter/API availability, accepted credential policy, budget/fencing/output publication and paid conformance for each retained provider

PROFILE.owner: Accounts and Access/profile worker owner; security reviewer
PROFILE.entryRequirement: Receive the qualified upstream saved-account/profile authority, encryption/retention and purge contract plus test environment; both-placement Universe use/purge tests follow.
PROFILE.completionEvidence: E8-F011/profile access, encryption/retention, revocation, measured teardown/purge and both-placement tests; signed-out success insufficient

V1_ACCEPTANCE.owner: TK acceptance; Codex evidence; technical reviewer assigned per batch
V1_ACCEPTANCE.entryRequirement: Completion-only decision: TK or recorded delegate accepts the combined V1 and rollback evidence after E8.2/2 runs. Never a prerequisite for running the acceptance rehearsal.
V1_ACCEPTANCE.completionEvidence: Every retained V1 slice and integrated UAT/recovery/rollout accepted. Any required blocked mode keeps V1 open

V2_APPROVAL.entryRequirement: Require completed and accepted E8.2/2 and explicit V2 implementation approval. V1 waits never authorize V2.
V2_APPROVAL.completionEvidence: V1 accepted complete and explicit separate V2 implementation scope approval; multi-screen is outside the 31-slice packet

LOCAL_SPEECH.entryRequirement: Provide authorized supported OS/hardware, permitted model/distribution and measurable resource constraints; actual installation/disconnect performance is qualification output.
LOCAL_SPEECH.completionEvidence: Actual OS/hardware/model installation/update/resource and disconnect qualification

executionRules.batchSemantics: Priority slots, not all-previous-slot barriers or separately mandated approval rounds. A package runs only after its explicit requires edges, applicable entry gates, resource ownership and approved scope are satisfied.
executionRules.parentCompletion: All child packages and original increment acceptance must pass; suffixes partition delivery, never add scope.
executionRules.implementationAuthorization: Not granted by this sequencing packet. Approve bounded batch scope after discussion; routine in-scope engineering corrections need no repeated permission.
executionRules.externalGateSemantics: Entry binding/environment and completion qualification are different. Discovery may produce a reviewed binding before consumer coding. Missing real upstream producers block consumers; writing a protocol is not evidence of runtime readiness.
executionRules.resourceRule: One writer per shared schema/migration chain, shared exports, authority route/service or panel controller; integrator serializes overlapping changes. Different lane labels do not prove disjoint files.
executionRules.handoffSemantics: requires refers to accepted package delivery, not full parent-increment closure. acceptanceAfter records deferred original acceptance. A frozen contract handoff can unblock a consumer while its parent awaits that consumer test.
